title: One audit-DPI contract: the classical path-space arrow as the commutative limit of quantum relative-entropy monotonicity

original_card.one_sentence_claim: The classical "no-false-arrows" path-space KL data-processing inequality (deterministic coarse-graining cannot increase forward/reverse path KL, micro >= macro) and the quantum relative-entropy DPI under CPTP maps are two specializations of one coarsening-monotone audit contract A(Q mu, Q mu') <= A(mu, mu'), with the classical arrow being the commutative (diagonal-subalgebra) restriction of Petz/Lindblad monotonicity via a measurement-coarsening conditional-expectation channel.
original_card.shared_mechanism: audit-DPI: a single coarsening-monotone audit functional A obeying the contract A(Q_f mu, Q_f mu') <= A(mu, mu'). Instantiated as relative entropy, this contract is exactly monotonicity of a monotone f-divergence under a positive trace-preserving channel (Petz/Lindblad-Uhlmann). The quantum case is A = S(rho||sigma) under a general CPTP map; the classical case is A = path-reversal KL Sigma_T under a deterministic partition lens, which is the SAME monotonicity restricted to a commutative (diagonal) von Neumann subalgebra with the lens realized as the conditional-expectation channel onto that subalgebra. Only the algebra (commutative vs full) and the channel (measurement-coarsening vs general CPTP) change across domains; the monotone-divergence object is one.

original_card.minimum_viable_unification: On finite dimensions, write the commutative-subalgebra corollary EXPLICITLY: (i) self-contain the classical NG_ARROW_DPI proof (log-sum DPI + reversal/observation commutation, TV case Lean-certified); (ii) record the quantum relative-entropy DPI as the cited noncommutative parent with the 0-violation regression table; (iii) show that restricting the CPTP channel to the dephasing conditional-expectation E_D onto the diagonal subalgebra reduces quantum monotonicity S(rho||sigma) >= S(E_D rho || E_D sigma) to classical KL-DPI of the diagonals, then lift coordinatewise along the path measure to recover the Sigma_T arrow-DPI. This exhibits the classical path-KL arrow as the commutative (diagonal-subalgebra) LIMIT of quantum Petz monotonicity -- one audit-DPI contract, two algebra specializations -- as a stated, finite, checkable corollary.
original_card.baseline_comparison: HONEST: this is recovery-and-reorganization of two standard data-processing inequalities, not new physics or new mathematics. The unifying object -- monotonicity of a monotone f-divergence under a channel, with a commutative von Neumann subalgebra as a special case of a noncommutative one -- is textbook prior art (Lindblad 1975, Petz 1986, Uhlmann, Wilde; Cover-Thomas for the classical DPI; Esposito for the coarse-graining entropy-production bound). The classical-as-commutative-limit-of-Petz relationship is well known to quantum-information theorists. The baselines this competes against ALREADY contain the relationship; SBT names it in a uniform 'audit-DPI' vocabulary and proves only the elementary classical leg. Distinctive feature: this is the program's single most parameter-rigid, opposite-world-INELASTIC cross-domain claim (the inequalities MUST hold; no lens choice flips their direction), so unlike the elastic geometry/quantum cards it cannot retrodict its own negation -- but rigidity is not novelty.
original_card.honest_status_note: MOSTLY BEATS the deflation critique with one honest gap. The genuine reply is that the parent-and-limit structure is the ONE place SBT could earn a real unification: the commutative-subalgebra corollary is a TRUE, derivable theorem -- the classical KL-DPI IS the diagonal-subalgebra restriction of Petz monotonicity. THE GAP: SBT has NOT written the lemma -- it is only NAMED -- so as it stands 'one contract' is carried by naming, and the unifying bridge is quality 1. Two further honest deductions: (a) the quantum leg is imported wholesale and presupposes the disclaimed Born/CPTP substrate, so the 'parent' half is not SBT content; (b) even once written, the underlying Petz fact is decades-old textbook prior art, so the strongest honest verdict is RECOVERY-OF-A-KNOWN-RELATIONSHIP (is_actually_new = false).

audit.audit_verdict: HONEST RECOVERY-OF-A-KNOWN-RELATIONSHIP; LOW COMPRESSION; MERELY-REPACKAGES = TRUE; the strongest INELASTIC card in the program but its single unifying step is aspirational. U009 is the cleanest place SBT could earn a real cross-domain unification because the target relationship is TRUE and derivable -- classical KL-DPI literally is the diagonal-subalgebra restriction of quantum Petz monotonicity, a genuine limit, not a per-domain analogy -- and because it is opposite-world INELASTIC. BUT: (1) the load-bearing commutative-subalgebra lemma is NAMED, not written (bridge quality 1), though the channel it needs (E_D = Delta) already exists, so the MVU is days-to-weeks of real-but-elementary work; (2) the quantum 'parent' is imported wholesale and presupposes the Born/CPTP substrate SBT disclaims; (3) even fully written, the Petz-restriction fact is textbook prior art -- is_actually_new=false, no new bound or physics, baseline_advantage 1/5. Of the seven anti-superficial controls, only same_word and elasticity PASS outright; shared_mechanism, bridge_map, hidden_import, compression, and surprise FAIL on the written corpus, but four of them (all but surprise) FLIP TO PASS if the finite commutative-subalgebra corollary is written and ideally mechanized. NET: not all-analogy (two genuine quality-4 legs), but a recovery whose single unifying step is decorative until the one elementary lemma is proved. Recommend the MVU/recovery-note artifact, honest-scope-boxed as recovery, never as new physics, with the Sigma_T informational-proxy disclaimer attached.
